title: 春怨（打起黄莺儿）
author: 金昌绪
intro: A young wife chases an oriole off the branch. Why? Its singing woke her from a dream in which she was travelling to see her husband at the frontier.
analysis: 这首诗用一位年轻女子的口气，像讲一件小事：把黄莺赶走吧，别让它在树枝上叫。它一叫，就把我的梦惊醒了，我就到不了辽西了。读到最后才明白：她的丈夫在遥远的辽西守边，她只能在梦里去见他。全诗一句接一句地追问原因，像剥洋葱一样，最后才露出真正的心事——这叫“层层倒叙”。春天本来美好，黄莺叫声也好听，她却嫌它吵，可见思念有多深。诗里没有一个“想”字，却写尽了妻子对丈夫的牵挂，也写出了战争给普通家庭带来的分离。语言像民歌一样简单活泼。
analysisEn: A young woman speaks as if telling us about something small: “Shoo that oriole away — don’t let it sing on the branch. When it sings it startles me out of my dream, and then I can’t get to Liaoxi.” Only at the last word do we understand. Her husband is a soldier far away in Liaoxi, on the northeastern frontier, and the only way she can reach him is in her dreams. Each line explains the one before it, peeling back layers until the real feeling appears at the end. Spring is lovely and the oriole’s song is sweet, yet she finds it a nuisance — that tells us how much she misses him. The word “miss” never appears, but the whole poem is longing, and quietly a complaint about the wars that kept families apart. Its language is simple and lively, like a folk song, and it reads almost like a tiny story with a twist.
background: Almost nothing is known about Jin Changxu except that he came from Hangzhou; this is his only surviving poem. Tang soldiers were stationed for years at Liaoxi, in today’s Liaoning region.
pronunciation: 莫教 jiāo（使、让，不读 jiào）。啼 tí。
version: 采用通行版本（《唐诗三百首》）。题目一作《伊州歌》。

lines.en: Go on, chase that oriole away —

lines.lit: don’t let it sing on the branch.
lines.en: don’t let it sing up on the branch.

lines.lit: When it sings, it startles my dream,
lines.en: Its song breaks into my dream,

lines.lit: and I cannot get to Liaoxi.
lines.en: and I never reach him in Liaoxi.

words.en: to chase off; to drive away

words.note: 古义是“使、让”，现代汉语说“让”。

words.en: Liaoxi, a frontier region in the northeast
words.note: 唐代边塞，在今辽宁一带。

imagery.name: 莺
imagery.zh: 黄莺的叫声本来动听，却惊醒了她的梦，所以她要把它赶走。
imagery.en: The oriole’s song is normally sweet, but it wakes her from her dream — so she wants it gone.

imagery.name: 梦
imagery.zh: 只有在梦里她才能到辽西见到丈夫，梦被打断是她最大的怨。
imagery.en: Only in dreams can she reach her husband in Liaoxi; a broken dream is her real grievance.
